data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 15.1 million, (2015: GBP 16.0 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance. prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance-to-close (RITC) added gross reserves of GBP 148.677m (reinsurers' share GBP 21.710m) to the syndicate's claims outstanding in 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior year release of GBP 12.896m (a c.3.9% reduction on opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 327.927m). Net of reinsurance the improvement was GBP 15.123m. The favourable movement was driven by favourable claims development across several classes (notably third party liability, fire/property, marine and accident & health) and was recorded alongside a significant RITC addition of GBP 148.677m to gross reserves in 2016.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 15.1 million, (2015: GBP 16.0 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
The large increase in ultimate claims between three and four years later for the 2011 pure underwriting year is predominantly due to the RITC's of syndicates 1965 and 2243 in 2015.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from statement of financial position (liabilities) 2015 comparative column. Prior year movement gross figure taken from 'Change in prior year provisions' row in Technical Provisions note (gross column). The class-by-class movement table in the Claims note appears to report NET movements (net of expected reinsurance recoveries) - lob_movements use those net figures (confidence lowered accordingly). RITC entries distort development and are separately reported; the claims development triangle is present but partially blank and affected by RITC (triangle data extracted with moderate confidence). Marine premium shows a parenthesised '(1)' in the statutory premium split which appears as negative GBP 1k in the table; that is reproduced as -0.001m.
